description.value: Lake Breeze Vineyards is a family-owned estate winery on the Naramata Bench above Lake Okanagan, with vines first planted in 1985 that rank among the oldest on the bench. The property features The Patio Restaurant serving seasonally inspired, locally sourced plates designed to pair with their estate wines, as well as a daily-open wine shop and tasting room. Located just minutes from both Naramata village and Penticton, it sits directly on one of BC's most celebrated cycling corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active winery/restaurant on the Naramata Bench. Phone number (250) 496-5659 and address 930 Sammet Rd, Naramata match OSM exactly. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null; the patio restaurant and wine shop are well documented as the core offering.
concerns: Postal code inconsistency on website: footer shows V0H 1N0 on some pages and V0H 1N1 on others — should be verified.
No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill confirmed from website; a direct contact or site visit is recommended to complete the WWC checklist.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established estate winery with an on-site restaurant directly on the Naramata Bench cycling corridor; a clear and natural stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drink. Bike-specific amenity details should be gathered via a site visit or direct contact.
